aggregateSchema: Fixed columns: rowType, controller, scenario, metric, n, mean, std, min, max, positiveRatio, improvementRatio, lowerIsBetter. rowType=controller_summary|paired_delta. For paired_delta: delta=MPC-Rule, positiveRatio=mean(delta>0), improvementRatio=mean(delta<0) since all metrics are lower-is-better.
forecastAssumption: MPC receives the exact synthetic rainfall and ET values only inside its finite prediction window. This is a perfect short-horizon forecast assumption and may overestimate performance relative to forecast-error conditions.
disclaimer: All results are from synthetic software-in-the-loop experiments. No water-saving rate, yield increase, or field validity is claimed.
